summary: Named after the picturesque Greek island known for its rich culture and stunning views, Tinos combines the charm of the Mediterranean with the taste of time-honored recipes.

name: Tinto Tapas Restaurant & Wine Bar
summary: Indulge in the art of sharing and enjoy an elevated tapas experience in Tinto Tapas Restaurant & Wine Bar's cozy and inviting space.

name: Togyushi
summary: Togyushi blends two experiences: a fine dining omakase counter showcasing traditional techniques, and a more casual wagyu bistro bar and lounge offering small plates, signature cocktails and Japanese vinyl culture.

name: Tonchin Brooklyn
summary: A modern Japanese restaurant featuring a full a la carte menu grounded in traditional flavors, with a New American twist.

name: Trapizzino
summary: Sink your teeth into Italian-style stuffed sandwich pockets on the Lower East Side.

name: Trattoria Dell'Arte
summary: A favorite of concert goers at nearby Carnegie Hall, Trattoria Dell'Arte is a design landmark, thanks to an interior done by the legendary Milton Glaser, and a entrance marked by a giant white nose.

name: Traveler
summary: Traveler is a laid-back bistro that celebrates Asian pop culture and flavors, changing with the seasons to bring a new destination into focus.

name: Travelers Poets & Friends
summary: Travelers Poets & Friends captures the essence of the Italian coastline with its authentic offerings.

name: Tucci
summary: Tucci, New York's newest Italian restaurant, serves refined modern Italian cuisine and family recipes in a warm and inviting atmosphere.

name: Tudor City Steakhouse
summary: Located in a historic enclave, Tudor City Steakhouse is a "next generation" steakhouse, offering dishes not typically associated with the genre.

name: Tuome
summary: Tuome is a critically acclaimed East Village restaurant by chef/owner Thomas Chen, whose ingredient-driven contemporary American menu showcases his classic culinary training with Asian influences.

name: Union Square Cafe
summary: The flagship business launched Danny Meyer’s Union Square Hospitality Group.

name: Upon The Palace
summary: Rooted in heritage and inspired by innovation, Upon The Palace is a premier Asian Fusion restaurant in Tribeca where the grandeur of ancient China meets the artistry of modern cuisine.

name: Uva Next Door
summary: Seasonal Italian classics and fantastic Amalfi style pizza paired with a cocktail-forward beverage program make Uva Next Door the playful little sister to the original Uva.

name: Veeray da Dhaba
summary: Founded by Michelin-starred chef Hemant Mathur, Veeray Da Dhaba brings Punjabi food to the East Village, celebrating slow-cooked classics, vibrant spices and the warm hospitality of Punjabi culture.

name: Veerays
summary: Located in Manhattan's Midtown East, Veerays is NYC’s first Indian speakeasy restaurant, envisioned by Michelin-starred chef Hemant Mathur.

name: Verde on Smith
summary: Verde on Smith is Cobble Hill, Brooklyn's neighborhood eatery, featuring regional Italian cuisine complemented by friendly service and warm ambiance.

name: Veselka
summary: Find 24-hour comfort food and Ukrainian specialties at this East Village standby.

name: Via 13
summary: Via 13, set in the West Village, serves the essence of Italy today—bold flavors, warm hospitality, and surprising twists make every visit unforgettable.

name: Victor's Cafe
summary: Victor’s, in the Theatre District, has been a redoubt for high-end Cuban food since 1963.

name: Vin Sur Vingt - E. 51st St.
summary: Vin Sur Vingt, from Sébastien Auvet (a wine enthusiast of the modern era, emphasizing simplicity, authenticity, and value), offers an impressive wine selection alongside a tapas-style French fare menu.

name: Viv
summary: Viv is a design-forward Thai restaurant and cocktail bar in Hell’s Kitchen with a lively nightlife scene in later hours.

name: Wabi Nori - Lower East Side
summary: Wabi Nori offers an elevated interpretation of traditional Japanese cuisine on Manhattan's Lower East Side.

name: Wabi Nori - Queens
summary: Wabi Nori Queens is a modern omakase experience featuring artfully prepared hand rolls and signature cocktails, all set within an intimate atmosphere and a beautifully curated menu.

name: Wallsé
summary: This modern European restaurant offers an impeccable integration between fine dining and fine art.

name: Wan Waan
summary: The team at Wan Waan, a Thai restaurant in the Chelsea neighborhood of Manhattan, emphasizes feelings through the taste of food.

name: Wayan
summary: Intoxicating Indonesian food from a talented chef in Nolita.

name: Wayward Fare
summary: Wayward Fare, a rustic and elegant culinary journey in Prospect Heights, offers a seasonally charged menu that weaves together a tapestry of some lesser-known Mediterranean flavors.

name: When in Bangkok
summary: When in Bangkok is a Thai restaurant that will transport you to a kitchen in Bangkok.

name: Yakiniku Futago
summary: Sleek and dimly lit Yakiniku Futago specializes in Japanese barbecue.

name: Yakiniku Gen - East Village
summary: Yakiniku Gen offers a truly authentic Japanese BBQ dining experience with more than 70 branches in Japan and five in NYC.

name: Yakiniku Gen - Midtown
summary: Yakiniku Gen offers a truly authentic Japanese BBQ dining experience with more than 70 branches in Japan and five in NYC.

name: Yakiniku Toraji An
summary: Toraji is a "yakiniku" style BBQ restaurant that serves thicker cuts of meat to better convey their delicious taste.

name: Yama Ramen
summary: This Japanese eatery serves ramen, sushi, teriyaki, pork buns and more on its extensive menu.

name: YongChuan
summary: Yong Chuan NYC offers a modern take on Ningbo and Eastern Chinese cuisine on Manhattan's Lower East Side.

name: Zaytinya
summary: Zaytinya offers an innovative mezze menu inspired by Turkish, Greek and Lebanese cuisines served up in a sleek and modern setting.

name: Zero Otto Nove - Flatiron
summary: Roberto Paciullo's Flatiron District restaurant combines the menu of Paciullo's other Bronx outpost, Roberto's Restaurant, with that of the original Zero Otto Nove.

name: Zoì Mediterranean NoMad
summary: Located within The Life Hotel, a landmark of elegance and history, Zoì offers a refined yet welcoming dining experience where tradition meets innovation.

name: Zoì Mediterranean UES
summary: Blue Mezze Bar - UES is a unique Mediterranean restaurant/bar on Manhattan's Upper East Side with an extensive mezze and cocktail menu, ideal for sharing and tasting.

name: Zuma
summary: Zuma, the brainchild of award-winning co-founder and creator Rainer Becker, brings its internationally acclaimed style of modern Japanese cuisine to Midtown Manhattan.
